reply_text: Marcus, the main contact for Quarrendon Freight Lines is **Thea Ramaswell**, Director of Yard Operations. The undated North cheat sheet lists her that way. Dana replied then that a driver had checked in at the kiosk and dispatch had added him manually, so the same trailer showed up in two rows. Dana was handling that thread, so ask her for the current status before your 10:00.
